name: fork_is_final
description: A fork is final (design 3.4): the Arrow Tower forked to branch A stands as the Longbow Loft (FORKED names the form); a second fork, to either branch, is ALREADY_FORKED and changes neither its numbers nor the gold; a teammate's fork is NOT_YOURS; a branch that does not exist is BAD_COMMAND.

steps.msg: branch A: FORKED names the Longbow Loft

steps.assert: t[0].branch == 0 and t[0].dmg_c == 1600 and t[0].cd_t == 24 and scene.gold(1) == 1000 - 80 - 60
steps.msg: with its numbers, for the fork's price
a second fork, to either branch, is refused

steps.assert: t[0].branch == 0 and t[0].dmg_c == 1600 and not t[0].air and scene.gold(1) == 1000 - 80 - 60 and scene.events_where('FORKED', {'id': t[0].id}).size() == 1
steps.msg: and changes nothing: still the Longbow Loft, gold untouched
a teammate cannot fork it, and there is no third branch
